npcdefault.htm.text: I have nothing to say to you

Q00236_SeedsOfChaos/32332-01b.html.text: Katenar: Have you been waiting long? I am glad to see you. Have you come to question me on the limitations imposed by fate?
when: state STARTED; memo 3; qs.getMemoStateEx(1) == 2; player == c0

Q00236_SeedsOfChaos/32332-01z.html.text: Katenar: This is not an opportune time, unfortunately. I do not know if and when we will have the chance to meet again, but it cannot be now.

Q00236_SeedsOfChaos/32332-05z.html.text: Katenar: When night falls, vicious vampires appear in this forest. If you confront Vampire Wichard , a red gem will be revealed. I cannot touch it myself, but I would you to bring it back here.

Q00236_SeedsOfChaos/32332-02b.html.text: Katenar: Such a direct personality. But have you not already heard the story? In any event, it is not something you can understand simply by hearing... "Then what do I have to do?"

Q00236_SeedsOfChaos/32332-03b.html.text: Katenar: First, I must test whether you are someone capable of facing fate without flinching. It can be cruel, and not everyone is suited to challenge it.

Q00236_SeedsOfChaos/32332-04b.html.text: Katenar: When night falls, vicious Vampires appear in this forest. You must confront the Vampire Wizard and obtain a special red gem he possesses. You must bring it to me as soon as you can!

Q00236_SeedsOfChaos/32332-05b.html.text: Katenar: Bring me the gem and I will tell you what to do next. If I am not here when you return, speak with that wizard over there. He will be able to advise you. Good luck!
